title.narrative: Off the Streets - Promoting the rights of Children in Street Situations

description.narrative: The overall objective is an enabling environment, in which children in street situations are able to enjoy their right to a life of dignity, is realised though enhanced policies and social protection in Jordan.The specific objective is strengthened national systems to protect and fulfil the rights of children in street situations through an improved legal framework, capacity building of public service providers, and a social mobilization campaign.
